decision: Skill and Ultimate casts apply +5 Nightmare stacks (cap 20) to target zero and refresh the aggregate 3s duration (6s with awakening effect 4). Ticks are pre-scheduled HitDelivery events on a 1s grid anchored at first application (NeverReset; first tick +1s, no immediate tick), rebuilt on every reapply. Expiry follows RemoveSingleStackAndRefreshDuration, processed before a tick on coinciding timestamps. Each tick carries the native per-stack ATK ratio at the applying cast's talent coordinate plus the State.Damage.Dot tag; the stack multiplier ratio*clamp(count-1,0,20) is added in the coefficient-addition zone (k = k_native + sum(delta_k)) from the live count at tick time. The whole model is opt-in via the exact accepted model assumption, so existing hit-count assertions are unaffected.
